text:
rachel: Heads-up: VoltEdge asked for a focused performance run next week to produce marketplace numbers and a short co-announcement. Focus: perf/W, throughput at 95/99p, and kernel tuning artifacts. We need to confirm infra access, telemetry, and the announcement timeline.

jonas: Do they have VPN + perfmon enabled? Also which model/seq lengths?

alex-voltedge: I can enable VPN and perfmon. Tentative: enable by Tuesday EOD. We have 4 identical rigs (A-D).

kevin: Proposed test matrix: gptx-mini @ seq 512 / 2048, modes: baseline FP16, int8, q4_0. Kernel variants: stock, fused-attn, cuBLAS-optimized. Include KV-cache thrash and sustained steady-state runs.

ash: For tuning, we'll try two kernel flags: ATTEN_FUSE=1 and CUBLAS_TUNE=3. Also run with power-capped and uncapped to see perf/W delta.

maria: Telemetry minimum: host PDU watt (1s), per-socket package watts, GPU power, perf counters (IPC, L2 miss), per-request latency series. We'll store aggregated CSVs and high-res traces separately.

rachel: Owners: Jonas = bench ops; Kevin = kernel tuning; Maria = telemetry & analysis; Rachel = PM + announce. Agree?

jonas: Agreed. I'll do a dry-run Wed and full sweep Thu-Fri assuming VPN up. I'll need Alex to allow perfmon and kernel debug symbols.

bench-bot: Run scheduled: id=bench-1716123456 -> start=1716210000. Tests queued: baseline,int8,q4_0.

kevin: Please pin driver/stack in logs. Suggested stack: nvidia-driver 535.86, CUDA 12.1, cuBLAS 12.1. If VoltEdge cannot change stack, we run compatibility matrix and flag differences in the notes.

alex-voltedge: We can match that stack on rigs A/B. Rigs C/D are on older driver; we'll note it. VPN perfmon enabled on A/B.

rachel: Legal/DS: partner asked for raw traces. Legal likely needs an NDA addendum. For the pipeline, we can share aggregated csv+plots without addendum. I'll loop in legal.

maria: Telemetry bucket: s3://redwood-partner-voltedge/bench-1716123456. Write perms granted to voltedge-readonly@ for aggregated artifacts only. Raw traces pending NDA.

jonas: Runner snippet (for bench ops):
```bash
run-bench \
  --model gptx-mini \
  --seq 2048 \
  --modes baseline,int8,q4_0 \
  --dur 3600 \
  --telemetry s3://redwood-partner-voltedge/bench-1716123456 \
  --rvpn rig=A,B
```

kevin: Add a quality regression hook: compute token logprob delta and flag >0.5 drop. We should also diff generated samples for a quick spot-check.

rachel: Timeline: Tue EOD partner enables VPN; Wed dry-run; Thu kernel tuning; Fri final sweep. VoltEdge wants a draft blog the following Tue for their marketing team. Can we turn around numbers and sign-off by next Mon?

ash: If tuning goes smoothly, yes. But allow one extra day if we find a regression that needs rework.

jonas: Action items: 1) Alex to confirm VPN + perfmon by Tue EOD. 2) Bench ops to prepare harness + dashboard. 3) Kernel team to provide tuning knobs and safe defaults. 4) PM to open legal request for raw traces. 5) Marketing kickoff for embargoed co-announcement doc.

rachel: I'll send the kickoff note to Alex and copy legal + marketing. Thanks everyone — will post the run link after the dry-run.
